; Layer C1c, the sealer's engine half (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5): a
; published (frozen) overlay becomes a sealed run through the real build,
; with a Ribbon filter for the identity summary, is installed in the resident
; view of runs (fn2-run-installed), and the overlay is retired with its arena
; released, in one step. The engine half names runs and pages itself (a run
; counter and a physical-unit counter in the seal row) and keeps every sealed
; page resident in the verified-page cache; B's run-replacement member (GC2)
; makes the run durable (the device half). The sealer machine
; (machines-c-sealer.lisp) drives fn2-seal-step from its arms. One seal row;
; its continuation is the row (phase, the overlay, the next entry, the run).
;
; Order (C-SEAL-ORDER): an overlay is sealable when it is frozen and no
; overlay of its schema that is frozen, private or active has a smaller SEQ;
; of the sealable ones the least SEQ goes first. Run identifiers grow, so run
; order follows SEQ order, and every overlay a reader still meets is newer
; than every run, which is what the readers' newest-wins rules assume.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-groups")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; The seal row. WBASE: the build's six writer rows, then the filter's; FBASE:
; its field rows (the build's, then the decoded entry, then the filter
; writer's); CROW: its checker row (B's format-row map: 3 + the upload
; windows), whose digest stripe holds the six levels' parent-held hashes
; (regions 129-134) and the filter's (135); FILL: the page fill. RUN and UNIT
; count the identifiers handed out.
(defconst *fn2-seal-eb* *fn2-run-build-fields*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-fw* (+ *fn2-run-build-fields* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-field-rows* (+ *fn2-seal-fw* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-writer-rows* (+ 1 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-region* 129)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-region* (+ *fn2-seal-hash-region* *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(assert-event (and (< *fn2-fc-previous-seal* *fn2-seal-hash-region*) (< *fn2-seal-filter-region* *fn2-digest-stride*)))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-bytes* (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
; The schema whose runs carry a Ribbon filter: the identity summary (§4a),
; keyed by the name N, which the identity decision reads first; the filter
; holds each entry's name.
(defconst *fn2-seal-identity* *fn2-id-summary-sid*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-field* *fn2-identity-summary-entry-field-name*)
(defcolumns fn2-seals
 ((phase (:enum fn2-seal-phase (:idle :build :filter :install :failed :release)))
  (sub (:enum fn2-seal-sub (:open :clear :add :drive :finish :solve)))
  (history :u60) (history-incarnation :u60)
  (o :u32) (pos :u32) (sid :u60) (run :u60) (runs :u60) (units :u60)
  (top :u8) (rslot :u32) (rgen :u60) (runit :u60) (rcounter :u60) (entries :u60)
  (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (filter :bool) (funit :u60) (fcounter :u60)
  (wbase :u32) (fbase :u32) (crow :u32) (fill :u32) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)
  (k :u8) (rlo :u60) (ufirst :u60) (held :bool) (rg :u32) (sbase :u32) (cbase :u32) (qbase :u32) (rbase :u32)))

; Shapes (type, wfp, rows of every stobj returned), with every table's rows
; accessor folded (the shape lemmas of the callees are stated over them).
(defconst *fn2-seal-rows-folded*
 '(fn2-seals-rows fn2-run-cache-rows fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-restarts-rows
   fn2-ribbon-builds-rows fn2-ribbon-band-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows
   fn2-ranges-rows fn2-range-sources-rows fn2-run-cursors-rows fn2-run-paths-rows))
(defmacro fn2-seal-shape (fn args outs stobjs &optional (mode 't) reads)
 `(fn2-idc-fn-shape ,fn ,args ,outs ,stobjs ,mode ,(append reads *fn2-seal-rows-folded*)))

; Set the seal row's resources: idle, no run or unit handed out yet.
(defun fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (fn2-origin-physicalp history history-incarnation) (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 pagefill) (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*) (sub *fn2-seal-sub-open*) (o 0) (pos 0) (sid 0) (run 0)
                                  (history history) (history-incarnation history-incarnation)
                                  (runs 0) (units 0) (filter 0) (wbase wbase) (fbase fbase) (crow crow) (fill pagefill)
                                  (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))
; The merge's read resources (C5): range row RG, its eight sources from
; SBASE reading through run cursors from CBASE, the query key's field rows
; at QBASE and the sources' reader rows from RBASE.
(defun fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rg) (unsigned-byte-p 32 sbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 qbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rbase)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (k 0) (rlo 0) (held 0) (rg rg) (sbase sbase) (cbase cbase) (qbase qbase) (rbase rbase))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The pick. Does an overlay of schema SID among rows O.. (K) in phase frozen,
; private or active have a SEQ below SEQ?
(defun fn2-seal-older-p (k o sid seq fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (or (and (member (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays)
                       (list *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-private* *fn2-overlay-phase-active*))
               (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
               (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix seq)))
          (fn2-seal-older-p (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid seq fn2-overlays))))
(defun fn2-seal-sealable-p (o fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :guard (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)))
 (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)
      (not (fn2-seal-older-p (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays)
                             (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays))))
; The sealable overlay with the least SEQ among rows O.. (K); BEST the row
; count when none.
(defun fn2-seal-pick (k o best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-seal-pick (- k 1) (+ 1 o)
                 (if (and (fn2-seal-sealable-p o fn2-overlays)
                          (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                              (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)))))
                     o best)
                 fn2-overlays)))
(defthm fn2-seal-pick-natp
 (implies (natp best) (natp (fn2-seal-pick k o best fn2-overlays))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; Work is pending in the seal row when it is in a non-idle active phase
; (:build, :filter, :install, :release), or when it is :idle and a published overlay is
; sealable.
(defun fn2-seal-pending-p (fn2-seals fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seals fn2-overlays) :guard (and (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays))))
 (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals))
      (let ((phase (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals)))
       (or (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-build*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-filter*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-install*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-release*)
           (and (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*)
                (< (fn2-seal-pick (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays)
                   (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-seal-older-p fn2-seal-sealable-p fn2-seal-pick fn2-seal-pending-p))

; Retire overlay O (frozen -> free) and release its arena.
(defun fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-retire fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-release-countp)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      (slot (fn2-overlays-slot o fn2-overlays)) (gen (fn2-overlays-gen o fn2-overlays))
      (okind (fn2-overlays-okind o fn2-overlays)) (oslot (fn2-overlays-oslot o fn2-overlays)) (ogen (fn2-overlays-ogen o fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (fn2-pool-release-countp slot fn2-pool)) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-overlays) (fn2-ov-advance o *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-free* fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release slot gen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool)))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release-countp fn2-overlays-slot fn2-overlays-gen fn2-overlays-okind fn2-overlays-oslot fn2-overlays-ogen))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C5's merge, chosen when a seal starts (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5). The
; frozen overlay O of schema SID is sealed together with SID's newest live
; runs (a suffix in run order, so the new run, whose identifier is greater
; than every run's, stands where they stood); its inputs retire when it
; installs and their pages are released unit by unit after it (:release).
; Size-tiered: a run joins while its entries are at most twice the entries
; gathered so far (O's, then each joined run's), so a schema holds about
; log2(entries) runs and an entry is rewritten about log2(n) times. Every
; run joins (FORCE) when the 64 KiB class or the installed view has at most
; one free row left (backpressure: the next seal needs a page and a row, and
; a merge frees its inputs'), or when the schema already holds
; *fn2-seal-run-budget* runs (a reader merges at most eight sources of a
; schema; stage keeps its overlays to the other four, machines-c.lisp). At
; most seven runs join, the overlay being the eighth source.
(defconst *fn2-seal-run-budget* *fn2-idc-run-budget*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-merge-runs* 7)
; Live runs of SID among rows R.. (K), and free rows.
(defun fn2-seal-live-runs (k r sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
              (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid)) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-live-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) sid fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-seal-free-rows (k r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-free*) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-free-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 r) fn2-run-installed))))
(defthm fn2-seal-live-runs-natp (natp (fn2-seal-live-runs k r sid fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defthm fn2-seal-free-rows-natp (natp (fn2-seal-free-rows k r fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; The runs that join, newest first from below BOUND (I more at most), ACC
; the entries gathered: (mv count least-run).
(defun fn2-seal-select (i acc bound force sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix i) :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (posp i)) (mv 0 0))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid bound rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows))) (mv 0 0))
      (e (nfix (fn2-run-installed-entries r fn2-run-installed)))
      (run (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)))
      ((unless (or force (<= e (* 2 (nfix acc))))) (mv 0 0))
      ((mv n least) (fn2-seal-select (- i 1) (+ (nfix acc) e) run force sid fn2-run-installed)))
  (mv (+ 1 (nfix n)) (if (equal (nfix n) 0) run (nfix least)))))
; Free rows of the page class (its free count; 0 when the pool has no such class).
(defun fn2-seal-free-pages (fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-pool :guard (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
 (let ((class (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-run-page-size* fn2-pool)))
  (if (and (natp class) (< class (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))) (nfix (fn2-pool-free-count class fn2-pool)) 0)))
; Among rows R.. (K), the live schema with the greatest live-run count
; above BEST-N (smaller SID breaking ties): (mv best best-n).
(defun fn2-seal-most-runs (k r best best-n fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r) (natp best) (natp best-n))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
       (mv (nfix best) (nfix best-n)))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*))
       (fn2-seal-most-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) best best-n fn2-run-installed))
      (sid (nfix (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed)))
      (n (fn2-seal-live-runs (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) 0 sid fn2-run-installed))
      (better (or (< (nfix best-n) n) (and (equal n (nfix best-n)) (< sid (nfix best))))))
  (fn2-seal-most-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) (if better sid best) (if better n best-n) fn2-run-installed)))
(defthm fn2-seal-most-runs-types
 (and (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed)))
      (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))))
; Pressure on the shared installed-run rows or 64 KiB page pool: proactive
; (merge the sealing schema's runs regardless of size ratio, and compact idle
; multi-run schemas once overlays drain) vs urgent (preemptively compact a
; multi-run schema before sealing a schema with <= 1 live run so the last free
; installed row or page is never consumed without freeing inputs).
(defun fn2-seal-pressured-p (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))
  (or (<= (fn2-seal-free-rows rows 0 fn2-run-installed) (max 2 (floor rows 3)))
      (<= (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool) 8))))
(defun fn2-seal-urgent-p (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))
  (or (<= (fn2-seal-free-rows rows 0 fn2-run-installed) 2)
      (<= (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool) 2))))
; Overlay O of SID with E entries: (mv count least-run) of the runs joining it.
(defun fn2-seal-plan (sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let* ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
        (force (or (fn2-seal-pressured-p fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
                   (<= *fn2-seal-run-budget* (fn2-seal-live-runs rows 0 sid fn2-run-installed)))))
  (mv-let (k rlo) (fn2-seal-select *fn2-seal-merge-runs* e *fn2-u60-max* force sid fn2-run-installed)
   (mv (min *fn2-seal-merge-runs* (nfix k)) (nfix rlo)))))
(defthm fn2-seal-plan-types
 (and (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)))
      (<= (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)) *fn2-seal-merge-runs*)
      (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
 :rule-classes ((:linear :corollary (<= 0 (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:linear :corollary (<= (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)) *fn2-seal-merge-runs*))
                (:linear :corollary (<= 0 (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-plan sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))))
; Run-only compaction target when no overlay is merged in (O = overlays-rows):
; if a schema exceeds *fn2-seal-run-budget* live runs, or row/page pressure is
; active and some schema holds >= 2 live runs, compact up to *fn2-seal-merge-runs*
; newest runs of the schema with the most live runs: (mv sid k rlo), k = 0 when none.
(defun fn2-seal-compact-target (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((mv sid best-n) (fn2-seal-most-runs rows 0 0 0 fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (<= 2 best-n)
                    (or (< *fn2-seal-run-budget* best-n)
                        (fn2-seal-pressured-p fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
       (mv 0 0 0))
      ((mv k rlo) (fn2-seal-select *fn2-seal-merge-runs* 0 *fn2-u60-max* t sid fn2-run-installed))
      (k (min *fn2-seal-merge-runs* (nfix k))))
  (if (<= 2 k) (mv (nfix sid) k (nfix rlo)) (mv 0 0 0))))
(defthm fn2-seal-compact-target-types
 (and (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)))
      (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)))
      (<= (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)) *fn2-seal-merge-runs*)
      (natp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
 :rule-classes ((:linear :corollary (<= 0 (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:linear :corollary (<= 0 (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:linear :corollary (<= (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)) *fn2-seal-merge-runs*))
                (:linear :corollary (<= 0 (mv-nth 2 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 2 (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))))))
(defun fn2-seal-compact-pending-p (fn2-seals fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seals fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals))
      (equal (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals) *fn2-seal-phase-idle*)
      (mv-let (sid k rlo) (fn2-seal-compact-target fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
       (declare (ignore sid rlo))
       (<= 2 k))))

; whole seam (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c.lisp). The tables and the :prepare half are
; machines-c-successor.lisp's, stage machines-c-stage.lisp's (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-stage")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Bind (right after B's admission :ok, in the same transition): every slot's
; row enters BATCH's private overlay of its schema, the newest one with room
; or a held spare. Nothing here fails after an :ok stage but a broken
; invariant.

; Copy N bytes from [SOFF..) of SSLOT/SGEN (read under SK SS SG) to
; [DOFF..) of DSLOT/DGEN (written under the engine's owner). Interim until
; A-S8's fn2-pool-copy-across lands (D's interim is the same loop).
(defun fn2-idc-copy (n sslot sgen soff sk ss sg dslot dgen doff fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-pool :measure (nfix n) :guard (and (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp n) (natp soff) (natp doff)) :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
                                             fn2-pool-class-for fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance fn2-ov-insert
                                             fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-run-copy-row fn2-fold-apply fn2-fold-assign
                                             fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-cursor-start
                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (if (zp n) (mv :ok fn2-pool)
  (b* (((mv code byte) (fn2-pool-read sslot sgen soff sk ss sg fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-pool))
       ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-write dslot dgen doff byte *fn2-idc-owner-kind* *fn2-idc-owner-slot* *fn2-idc-owner-gen* fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-pool)))
   (fn2-idc-copy (- n 1) sslot sgen (+ 1 soff) sk ss sg dslot dgen (+ 1 doff) fn2-pool))))
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-idc-copy (n sslot sgen soff sk ss sg dslot dgen doff fn2-pool) :position 1
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write fn2-pool-rows))))

; An insert's octet fields J.. of the row at ENTRY copied into the scratch
; from OFF on (read under SK SS SG), each field then naming its copy.
(defun fn2-succ-rehome-octets (k j sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-fields fn2-pool) :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp j) (natp entry) (natp off))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-idc-copy fn2-fields-rows fn2-run-layout-octets-max)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp j) (natp entry) (natp off) (< (+ entry j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j))
       (fn2-succ-rehome-octets (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (row (+ entry j)) (len (fn2-fields-ref-len row fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp (fn2-fields-ref-off row fn2-fields)) (natp len) (unsigned-byte-p 32 off) (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ off len))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 sslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sgen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-idc-copy len (fn2-fields-ref-slot row fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-ref-gen row fn2-fields)
                                        (fn2-fields-ref-off row fn2-fields) sk ss sg sslot sgen off fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (ref-slot sslot) (ref-gen sgen) (ref-off off))))
  (fn2-succ-rehome-octets (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid entry (+ off len) sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-succ-rehome-octets (k j sid entry off sk ss sg sslot sgen fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (fn2-fields fn2-pool) t (fn2-run-layout-octets-max fn2-fields-ref-len fn2-fields-ref-off fn2-fields-ref-slot fn2-fields-ref-gen fn2-idc-copy))

; Integer fields J.. of the row at ENTRY given :event take EVENT.
(defun fn2-succ-fill-events (k j entry events event fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp entry))))
 (cond ((not (and (posp k) (natp j) (natp entry) (< (+ entry j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 event))) fn2-fields)
       ((fn2-succ-has events j)
        (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ entry j) event fn2-fields)))
         (fn2-succ-fill-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) entry events event fn2-fields)))
       (t (fn2-succ-fill-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) entry events event fn2-fields))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-fill-events (k j entry events event fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-succ-has))))

; Fold slot (SID, event KW): for each arg J.. (K of them) given :event, the
; entry field fn2-fold-event-field names (the value field its :set copies
; the arg into) takes EVENT; stage applied the step with 0 in its place.
(defun fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (k j sid kw entry events event fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp entry))))

       ((and (fn2-succ-has events j) (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j))
             (< (+ entry (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))
        (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ entry (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)) event fn2-fields)))

       (t (fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid kw entry events event fn2-fields))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-fill-fold-events (k j sid kw entry events event fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-succ-has))))

; BATCH's newest private overlay of SID (greatest SEQ) among rows O.. (K of
; them); BEST the row count when none.
(defun fn2-succ-newest-private (k o b sid best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-succ-newest-private (- k 1) (+ 1 o) b sid
                           (if (and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-private*)
                                    (equal (fn2-overlays-batch o fn2-overlays) b) (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                                    (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                                        (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)))))
                               o best)
                           fn2-overlays)))
; The overlay slot rows of SID and SIZE bytes go into for BATCH: its newest
; private one with room, else a spare that becomes BATCH's (its SEQ the
; engine's next). (mv code o engine overlays)
(defun fn2-succ-target (b sid size fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays) :guard (and (fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* ((rows (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (o (fn2-succ-newest-private rows 0 b sid rows fn2-overlays))
      ((when (and (natp o) (< o rows)
                  (<= (+ (nfix (fn2-overlays-fill o fn2-overlays)) (nfix size)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-cap o fn2-overlays)))
                  (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-count o fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-icap o fn2-overlays)))))
       (mv :ok o fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))
      (s (fn2-idc-find-overlay rows 0 *fn2-overlay-phase-spare* 0 fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (and (< s rows) (< 0 (fn2-id-engine-rows fn2-id-engine)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 b) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid)))
       (mv :spare 0 fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))
      (seq (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-id-engine-seq 0 fn2-id-engine))))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 seq)) (mv :bounds 0 fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-set-seq 0 seq fn2-id-engine))
      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-put s (phase *fn2-overlay-phase-private*) (batch b) (schema sid) (seq seq))))
  (mv :ok s fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-succ-target (b sid size fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays) ((fn2-id-engine 2) (fn2-overlays 3))

                   (sslot (fn2-id-engine-slot 0 fn2-id-engine)) (sgen (fn2-id-engine-gen 0 fn2-id-engine))

; since its stage (C-S3a).
(defun fn2-succ-unfilled (k i tx fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-slots :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (natp i) (natp tx))))

      (let ((s (+ (* (nfix tx) *fn2-succ-slots*) i)))
       (or (and (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                (not (equal (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots))
                                    (lognot (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-filled s fn2-succ-slots))))

;; A stage's conclusions hold while the tip it read is unchanged; the tip
;; changes at a bind and at a drop (a publish changes no content a stage
;; reads; a seal moves the run version, which stage already checks). So a
;; bind (of every transaction but EXCEPT) and a drop return every other
;; :staged transaction to :open: its bind then answers :state until it
;; stages again (c-ordered-runs.md §8, the tip scan's invariant).
(defun fn2-succ-unstage (k tx except fn2-succ-txns)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-txns :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (natp tx))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)))) fn2-succ-txns)
      (fn2-succ-txns (if (and (not (equal tx except))
                              (equal (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-phase-staged*))

                    (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase i fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))

; The stage-side wrappers, in their own assembly book (assembly-callbacks-c-
; commit): the one-minute rule (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
;; A hook's attachment. Each constraint of the hook is proved of the
;; attachment by itself: the hook's -CONSTRAINT and -RESULT-CONSP (FN's
;; definition opened, its KIDS contract used), its KIDS by FN's contract and,
;; where the hook keeps the stored owners (commit.lisp
;; fn2-commit-hook-owners-claim), that by FN's owner chain (dispatch-held.lisp)
;; at the commit kind; the defattach then only cites them.
(defun fn2-succ-frame-nths (ks free out)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom ks) nil
  (cons `(:instance fn2-arm-kids-nth (i 0) (k ,(car ks)) (free ',free) (a fn2-core) (b ,out))
        (fn2-succ-frame-nths (cdr ks) free out))))

 ; the hook's -CONSTRAINT of FN from FN's preservation lemmas and its KIDS
 ; contract (the frame children are outside its children), FN closed

 (let ((free (fn2-arm-frame-indices (cdr (assoc-eq hook *fn2-commit-hook-children*)) world))
       (out `(mv-nth 1 (,fn ,@(formals hook world)))))
  `(("Goal" :in-theory (union-theories '(,@*fn2-commit-hook-frame* ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-TYPE")
                                         ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-WFP"))
                                       (theory 'fn2-arm-frame-base))
     :use ((:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS") (fn2-arm-free ',free) (fn2-arm-c0 fn2-core))
           (:instance fn2-arm-kids-refl (i 0) (free ',free) (a fn2-core))
           ,@(fn2-succ-frame-nths (fn2-arm-frame-indices *fn2-commit-hook-frame* world) free out))))))
(defun fn2-succ-attach-lemmas (names hook fn world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil

; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8),
; stage (every write slot against the tip, then room) and out. The tables
; and the :prepare half are machines-c-successor.lisp's; bind, release,
; publication, the defcosts and the core wrappers machines-c-bind.lisp's
; (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-successor")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version fn2-succ-bit fn2-succ-has)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Stage (in the :ready arm): every slot in order against the tip, then room.
; The tip of a key is its newest row: in the overlays of its schema (a
; batch's private ones, published ones, active ones), the one taken last
; (greatest SEQ) holding it; else the row resolve read from the installed
; runs if their version has not moved (else :stale); else none (zeros).

; Headroom for :event fields (each staged as 0 = 1 varint byte, bound as a u60
; = up to 9 varint bytes, so at most +8 bytes per :event field).
(defun fn2-succ-event-headroom (k j events)
 (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (natp k) (natp j))))
 (if (zp k) 0
  (+ (if (fn2-succ-has events j) 8 0)
     (fn2-succ-event-headroom (- k 1) (+ 1 (nfix j)) events))))
(defthm fn2-succ-event-headroom-natp
 (natp (fn2-succ-event-headroom k j events)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(in-theory (disable fn2-succ-event-headroom))

; Args 0..N-1 of a slot from SRC into DST: an :out arg reads its slot's
; staged row (field F of slot K, at B0 + 48K + F), an :event arg is 0 until
; bind, any other is copied (value and octet reference).
(defun fn2-succ-eval-arg (j src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp src) (natp dst) (natp b0))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp j) (natp src) (natp dst) (natp b0) (< (+ src j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< (+ dst j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       fn2-fields)
      ((unless (fn2-succ-has outs j))
       (if (fn2-succ-has events j) (fn2-fields-put (+ dst j) (value 0) (ref-len 0))
         (fn2-succ-copy-row (+ src j) (+ dst j) fn2-fields)))
      (h (fn2-fields-value (+ src j) fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* (floor h 256)) (mod h 256)))
      ((unless (and (natp row) (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) fn2-fields))
  (fn2-fields-put (+ dst j) (value (fn2-fields-value row fn2-fields)) (ref-len 0))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-eval-arg (j src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t)
(defun fn2-succ-eval-args (k j src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp k) (natp j) (natp src) (natp dst) (natp b0))))
 (if (or (zp k) (not (and (natp j) (natp src) (natp dst) (natp b0)))) fn2-fields
  (let ((fn2-fields (fn2-succ-eval-arg j src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields)))
   (fn2-succ-eval-args (- k 1) (+ 1 j) src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-eval-args (k j src dst b0 outs events fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t)

; Whether integer fields J..N-1 of the row at ENTRY fit schema SID.
(defun fn2-succ-fits (k j sid entry fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp j) (natp entry))))
 (or (not (posp k))
     (and (natp j) (natp entry) (< (+ entry j) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
          (or (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j) (fn2-run-layout-value-ok sid j (fn2-fields-value (+ entry j) fn2-fields)))
          (fn2-succ-fits (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid entry fn2-fields))))
; The mask of a fold event's args that are not assigned, J..N-1.
(defun fn2-succ-required (k j sid kw)
 (declare (xargs :guard (natp j) :measure (nfix k)))
 (if (or (not (posp k)) (not (natp j)) (<= 32 j)) 0
  (logior (if (fn2-fold-assigned-p sid kw j) 0 (fn2-succ-bit j)) (nfix (fn2-succ-required (- k 1) (+ 1 j) sid kw)))))

; The overlay holding the key at QBASE newest (greatest SEQ) among the
; readable or private overlays of SID, rows O.. (K of them): (mv code best
; pos fields), BEST the row count when none does. EB is decode scratch.
(defun fn2-succ-tip-scan (k o sid qbase eb qk qs qg best bpos fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
              (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp o))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-locate fn2-fields-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) (mv :ok best bpos fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                    (member (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays)
                            (list *fn2-overlay-phase-active* *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-private*))))
       (fn2-succ-tip-scan (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid qbase eb qk qs qg best bpos fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code pos order fn2-fields) (fn2-ov-locate o eb qbase qk qs qg fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code best bpos fn2-fields))

  (mv :ok fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))

;; The arms. :sealing: one seal step; more work keeps the row runnable;
;; nothing sealable (:idle) parks it on :sealable, which the grant service
;; wakes once an overlay is sealable. A seal that needs a page or a run row
;; merges first (C5, sealer.lisp: it joins the schema's runs whenever one
;; free page or row is left, and its install and release free theirs), so
;; :full is a pool that cannot hold one batch's runs and a merge; with no
;; wake for that, every other answer stops the core by name through fn2-sealer-refuse (:full is
;; :sealer-full, :cache :sealer-cache, any other :sealer) rather than park a
;; row nothing would wake, and moves the row to :stopped.
(defmachine-arms fn2-sealer :declare
 :arms
 ((:sealing
   (:do (code) (fn2-sealer-step 4096)
    :accept ()
    :case (((:more :retired :done) (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-transition* :runnable t))
           ((:idle) (:park :sealable :steps *fn2-work-transition*))
           (:otherwise
            (:do () (fn2-sealer-refuse code))
            (:set (stopped 1)) (:next :stopped)
            (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-transition*)))))
  (:stopped (:idle))))

(defmacro fn2-sealer-core-events ()
 '(progn
   (assert-event (equal *fn2-sealer-kind* *fn2-idc-owner-kind*))
   (defun fn2-sealer-step (budget fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-seals (fn2-core-seals fn2-core)) (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core))
                (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-core)) (fn2-run-installed (fn2-core-run-installed fn2-core))
                (fn2-run-builds (fn2-core-run-builds fn2-core)) (fn2-run-writers (fn2-core-run-writers fn2-core))
                (fn2-run-restarts (fn2-core-run-restarts fn2-core)) (fn2-run-cache (fn2-core-run-cache fn2-core))
                (fn2-ribbon-builds (fn2-core-ribbon-builds fn2-core)) (fn2-ribbon-band (fn2-core-ribbon-band fn2-core))
                (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core))
                (fn2-fc-context (fn2-core-fc-context fn2-core)) (fn2-b3 (fn2-core-b3 fn2-core)) (fn2-digests (fn2-core-digests fn2-core))
                (fn2-ranges (fn2-core-ranges fn2-core)) (fn2-range-sources (fn2-core-range-sources fn2-core))
                (fn2-run-cursors (fn2-core-run-cursors fn2-core)) (fn2-run-paths (fn2-core-run-paths fn2-core)))
     (code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
           fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
           fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
     (fn2-seal-step budget fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                    fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                    fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
     (mv code fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-sealer-step (budget fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ;; Genesis: the seal row's resources, owned by the sealer's row. With no
   ;; checker row 3 + windows in the profile (C-SEAL-NO-ROW, interim until
   ;; B5-4a sizes the format tables for it in every profile) the answer is
   ;; :no-row and the caller stops the sealer's row: overlays then
   ;; accumulate as before C1c (capacity backpressure at stage).
   (defun fn2-sealer-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-seals (fn2-core-seals fn2-core)) (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core))
                (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core)))
     (code fn2-seals)
     (fn2-seal-genesis profile (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields) fn2-seals)
     (mv code fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-sealer-genesis (profile fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-core-wfp))))
   ;; C's attachment of the grant service's :sealable source: the sealer's
   ;; row is parked on :sealable in :sealing, its seal row is idle, and an
   ;; overlay is sealable. The grant clears the wait and wakes the row.
   (defun fn2-sealer-pending-p (fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-seals (fn2-core-seals fn2-core)) (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core))
                (fn2-run-installed (fn2-core-run-installed fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)))
     (yes)
     (or (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays)
         (fn2-seal-compact-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))
     yes))
   (defun fn2-sealer-ready (fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (let ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-sealer-kind* fn2-core)))
     (and (not (equal id *fn2-none*)) (fn2-machine-idp id fn2-core)
          (eq (fn2-machine-phase-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)
          (equal (fn2-machine-phase id fn2-core) *fn2-sealer-state-sealing*)
          (eq (fn2-machine-wait-reason-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)
          (equal (fn2-machine-wait-reason id fn2-core) *fn2-wait-sealable*)
          (fn2-sealer-pending-p fn2-core))))
   (defun fn2-sealer-grant (fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (fn2-sealer-ready fn2-core)
        (let* ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-sealer-kind* fn2-core))
               (fn2-core (fn2-machine-write-wait-reason id *fn2-wait-none* fn2-core)))
         (mv id fn2-core))
     (mv *fn2-none* fn2-core)))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-sealer-grant (fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
   (defthm fn2-sealer-ready-id
    (implies (fn2-sealer-ready fn2-core)
             (not (equal (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-sealer-kind* fn2-core) *fn2-none*)))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (e/d (fn2-sealer-ready) (fn2-machine-kind-base fn2-machine-idp fn2-sealer-pending-p)))))
   (defthm fn2-sealer-grant-live
    (implies (fn2-sealer-ready fn2-core)
             (not (equal (mv-nth 0 (fn2-sealer-grant fn2-core)) *fn2-none*)))
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (e/d (fn2-sealer-grant) (fn2-sealer-ready fn2-machine-write-wait-reason fn2-machine-kind-base)))))
   (defthm fn2-sealer-grant-type
    (and (consp (fn2-sealer-grant fn2-core)) (true-listp (fn2-sealer-grant fn2-core)))
    :rule-classes :type-prescription
    :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (e/d (fn2-sealer-grant) (fn2-sealer-ready fn2-machine-write-wait-reason)))))
   (in-theory (disable fn2-sealer-step fn2-sealer-genesis fn2-sealer-pending-p fn2-sealer-ready fn2-sealer-grant))
   ;; The attachment proves the pair's constraints (type, shape, liveness)
   ;; from the three lemmas above, the grant's preserves lemmas and its frame
   ;; within the defwait's :tables.
   (fn2-wait-attach :sealable fn2-sealer-grant)
   (defattach (fn2-sealable-ready-p fn2-sealer-ready) (fn2-sealable-grant-one fn2-sealer-grant)
    :hints (("Goal" :use ((:instance fn2-sealer-grant-live) (:instance fn2-sealer-grant-wait-kids) (:instance fn2-sealer-grant-wait-directory)))))
   ;; CODE names the stop: a pool exhausted (:full) or a cache row held by
   ;; another page (:cache) is :sealer-full / :sealer-cache, any other
   ;; refusal :sealer.
   (defun fn2-sealer-refuse (code fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (fn2-core-stop (case code (:full *fn2-stop-reason-sealer-full*) (:cache *fn2-stop-reason-sealer-cache*)
                     (otherwise *fn2-stop-reason-sealer*))
                   fn2-core))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-sealer-refuse (code fn2-core) :rows nil)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-sealer-refuse))
   (assert-event (fn2-assert-compliant-p '(fn2-sealer-step fn2-sealer-genesis fn2-sealer-pending-p fn2-sealer-ready
                                           fn2-sealer-grant fn2-sealer-refuse) (w state)))

   ;; Layer C's genesis, called once by the executor's fn2-init-engine:
   ;; the group directory (S-GROUP), the principal directory (fn2-principals'
   ;; anonymous and owner), then the seal row; with no checker row
   ;; (C-SEAL-NO-ROW) the sealer's row is stopped instead.
   ;; READY: park the row on :sealable (its seal row is set); else stop it.
   (defun fn2-sealer-start-row (ready fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (let ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-sealer-kind* fn2-core)))
     (if (and (not (equal id *fn2-none*)) (fn2-machine-idp id fn2-core))
         (if ready
             (let ((fn2-core (fn2-sealer-put-core id (wait-reason *fn2-wait-sealable*)))) (mv :ok fn2-core))
           (let ((fn2-core (fn2-sealer-put-core id (phase *fn2-sealer-state-stopped*) (stopped 1) (wait-reason *fn2-wait-none*))))
            (mv :ok fn2-core)))
      (mv :bounds fn2-core))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-sealer-start-row (ready fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
   (defun fn2-engine-genesis (profile fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (b* (((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-groups-genesis profile fn2-core))
         ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-core))
         ((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-principals-genesis profile fn2-core))
         ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-core))
         ((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-sealer-genesis profile fn2-core)))
     (if (member-eq code '(:ok :no-row)) (fn2-sealer-start-row (eq code :ok) fn2-core) (mv code fn2-core))))
   (fn2-core-preserves fn2-engine-genesis (profile fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-sealer-start-row fn2-engine-genesis))
   (defmachine-arms fn2-sealer)
   (defmachine-run fn2-sealer)))

; Layer C1c unit: the sealer's engine half (books/sealer.lisp) on real runs.
; Overlays of one schema are loaded through the real insert, published
; (frozen, SEQ in batch order) and sealed by driving the real fn2-seal-step
; until it is idle; then every query is looked up through the real run
; cursor in the installed runs, newest run first. The keystones
; fn2-sealer-run-equals-overlay and fn2-manifest-replacement-atomic, their
; adapters and teeth.
; Run: sh tools/certify.sh tests/sealer-unit.lisp
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "runs-assembly")
(include-book "../books/sealer")

(defconst *fn2-su-stobjs*
 '(fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache
   fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources))
;; A b* binding (fn2-su-bind (v ...) call) binds V ... and every stobj.
(defun fn2-su-expand (x)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom x) x)
       ((and (eq (car x) 'fn2-su-bind) (consp (cdr x)) (consp (cddr x)))
        (list (cons 'mv (append (cadr x) *fn2-su-stobjs*)) (fn2-su-expand (caddr x))))
       (t (cons (fn2-su-expand (car x)) (fn2-su-expand (cdr x))))))
(defmacro fn2-su-defun (name args &rest r)
 (let* ((measure (and (eq (car r) :measure) (cadr r))) (body (if measure (caddr r) (car r))))
  `(defun ,name ,(append args *fn2-su-stobjs*)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs ,*fn2-su-stobjs* :verify-guards nil ,@(and measure `(:measure ,measure))))
    ,(fn2-su-expand body))))
(defmacro fn2-su-mv (&rest values) `(mv ,@values ,@*fn2-su-stobjs*))
(defmacro fn2-su-call (name &rest args) `(,name ,@args ,@*fn2-su-stobjs*))

; Field plan: the sealer's rows from 1500 (its merge's query at 2780 and
; sources' readers from 2860, C5); an entry being loaded at 3700, the
; overlay's decode scratch at 3800; the run adapter's reader at 1200 and
; query at 1310. Writer rows 0-6 the sealer's; checker row 0, digest rows
; 0-135. Owner (9 0 1); the query's (10 0 1).
(defconst *fn2-su-fbase* 1500)
(defconst *fn2-su-e* 3700)
(defconst *fn2-su-eb* 3800)
(defconst *fn2-su-icap* 64)
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-setup (rows pfill)
 (b* ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-init 1 fn2-seals))
      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-init rows fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-overlay-index-init (* rows *fn2-su-icap*) fn2-overlay-index))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-init 16 fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-init 1 fn2-run-builds))
      (fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-init *fn2-seal-writer-rows* fn2-run-writers))
      (fn2-run-restarts (fn2-run-restarts-init (* *fn2-seal-writer-rows* *fn2-run-restart-capacity*) fn2-run-restarts))
      (fn2-run-cache (fn2-run-cache-init 1024 fn2-run-cache))
      (fn2-ribbon-builds (fn2-ribbon-builds-init 1 fn2-ribbon-builds))
      (fn2-ribbon-band (fn2-ribbon-band-init (fn2-ribbon-slots *fn2-su-icap*) fn2-ribbon-band))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-init 3900 fn2-fields))
      (fn2-pool (fn2-pool-init '((300 . 65536)) 1 100 fn2-pool))
      (fn2-fc (fn2-fc-init 1 fn2-fc))
      (fn2-fc-context (fn2-fc-context-init 1 fn2-fc-context))
      (fn2-b3 (fn2-b3-table-init 1 fn2-b3))
      (fn2-digests (fn2-digests-init 150 fn2-digests))
      (fn2-run-cursors (fn2-run-cursors-init 9 fn2-run-cursors))
      (fn2-run-paths (fn2-run-paths-init (* 9 *fn2-run-max-levels*) fn2-run-paths))
      (fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-init 1 fn2-ranges))
      (fn2-range-sources (fn2-range-sources-init 8 fn2-range-sources))
      ((mv code fn2-seals) (fn2-seal-init 0 *fn2-su-fbase* 0 pfill 9 0 1 1 1 fn2-seals))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv code))
      ;; the merge (C5): range row 0, sources 0-7 through cursors 1-8
      ((mv code fn2-seals) (fn2-seal-merge-rows 0 0 1 (+ *fn2-su-fbase* *fn2-seal-field-rows*)
                                                (+ *fn2-su-fbase* *fn2-seal-field-rows* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) fn2-seals)))
  (fn2-su-mv code)))
; Load overlay O of SID with ENTRIES (inserted in order), SEQ, then publish
; it (frozen) unless PRIVATE.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-load-entries (layout entries o src sgen off)
 (if (atom entries) (fn2-su-mv :ok)
  (b* (((mv code off fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-load-values layout (car entries) *fn2-su-e* src sgen off 9 0 1 fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
        (fn2-ov-insert o *fn2-su-e* *fn2-su-eb* fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :insert code))))
   (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load-entries layout (cdr entries) o src sgen off))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-load (sid layout batches o seqs private)
 (if (atom batches) (fn2-su-mv :ok)
  (b* (((mv & aslot agen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv & src sgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
        (fn2-ov-start o sid aslot agen (* o *fn2-su-icap*) *fn2-su-icap* 9 0 1 0 fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :start code)))
       (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load-entries layout (car batches) o src sgen 0))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv code))
       ((mv & fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release src sgen 9 0 1 fn2-pool))
       (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-set-seq o (car seqs) fn2-overlays))
       ((mv code fn2-overlays)
        (if (and (atom (cdr batches)) private)
            (fn2-ov-advance o *fn2-overlay-phase-active* *fn2-overlay-phase-private* fn2-overlays)
          (fn2-ov-freeze o fn2-overlays)))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :freeze code))))
   (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load sid layout (cdr batches) (+ 1 o) (cdr seqs) private))))
; Drive the sealer until it is idle or has installed LIMIT runs; (code
; done-count).
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-drive (fuel limit done) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (if (or (zp fuel) (and (natp limit) (<= limit done))) (fn2-su-mv (if (zp fuel) :fuel :limit) done)
  (b* (((mv code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
            fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
            fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
        (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                       fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                       fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)))
   (case code
    (:idle (fn2-su-mv :idle done))
    ((:more :retired) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive (- fuel 1) limit done))
    (:done (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive (- fuel 1) limit (+ 1 done)))
    (otherwise (fn2-su-mv code done))))))
; Look Q up in SID's live runs, newest first, below BOUND: (:found entry)
; from the first run holding its key, else (:absent).
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-lookup (fuel sid layout bound) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (b* ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid bound rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((when (or (zp fuel) (not (< r rows)))) (fn2-su-mv (list :absent)))
      ((mv & fn2-run-cursors)
       (fn2-run-cursor-start 0 sid (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-slot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-gen r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-run-reader* 9 0 1 fn2-run-cursors))
      ((mv code fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields) (fn2-run-run-steps 100000 fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
  (if (eq code :found)
      (fn2-su-mv (list :found (fn2-run-unload-values layout (+ *fn2-run-run-reader* *fn2-run-reader-entry*) fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
    (if (eq code :absent)
        (fn2-su-call fn2-su-lookup (- fuel 1) sid layout (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-su-mv (list code))))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-queries (sid layout queries)
 (if (atom queries) (fn2-su-mv nil)
  (b* (((mv & qslot qgen fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reserve 0 10 0 1 fn2-pool))
       ((mv & & fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-load-values layout (car queries) *fn2-run-run-query* qslot qgen 0 10 0 1 fn2-fields fn2-pool))
       (fn2-su-bind (answer) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-lookup 20 sid layout *fn2-u60-max*))
       ((mv & fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release qslot qgen 10 0 1 fn2-pool))
       (fn2-su-bind (rest) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-queries sid layout (cdr queries))))
   (fn2-su-mv (cons answer rest)))))
; The live runs' (schema run entries filter) and the overlay phases.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-installed (r k) :measure (nfix k)

  (b* ((live (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*))

; Specification: the newest batch (the last in SEQ order) holding Q's key.
(defun fn2-su-find (key entries q)

       ((eq (fn2-run-key-order-spec key (car entries) q) :eq) (list (car entries)))

  (let ((later (fn2-sealer-lookup-spec key (cdr batches) q)) (here (fn2-su-find key (car batches) q)))
   (if (eq (car later) :found) later (if here (list :found (car here)) later)))))

;; The engine half of the run replacement: at every cut of the sealer's
;; steps, the resident view holds the runs before the seal or the runs after
;; it, never a third set; the overlay is published until the cut that
;; installs its run and free from that cut on, so a reader sees each fact in
;; exactly one place. (The device half adds B5's recovery over the
;; run-replacement member: the recovered manifest is the old or the new.)
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-cuts (fuel prev acc) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (if (zp fuel) (fn2-su-mv (reverse acc))
  (b* (((mv code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
            fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
            fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
        (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                       fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                       fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths))
       (fn2-su-bind (installed) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 16))
       (fn2-su-bind (phases) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases 0 1))
       (view (list installed phases))
       (acc (if (equal view prev) acc (cons view acc))))
   (if (member-eq code '(:more :retired :done)) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-cuts (- fuel 1) view acc) (fn2-su-mv (reverse acc))))))
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-cut-run (sid layout batch pfill)

      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup code)))

      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (installed) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 16))
      (fn2-su-bind (phases) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-phases 0 1))
      (fn2-su-bind (views) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-cuts 100000 (list installed phases) (list (list installed phases)))))
  (fn2-su-mv views)))

;; Readiness across seal-row phases (Brick H4): when no overlay is sealable
;; (an older batch is private), :idle is not pending, every active non-idle
;; phase (:build, :filter, :install) stays pending so a parked sealer wakes to
;; finish its in-flight run, and :failed is not pending; with a sealable
;; overlay, :idle is pending. Also verify fn2-seal-cache refuses :cache when
;; the writer's direct-mapped cache row already holds a ready page.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-pending-check ()
 (b* ((fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-setup 3 400))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (code)

                     (list (fn2-su-batch 0 3 100) (fn2-su-batch 3 3 100)) 0 '(2 1) t))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
      (p-idle-blocked (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-build* fn2-seals))
      (p-build (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-filter* fn2-seals))
      (p-filter (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-install* fn2-seals))
      (p-install (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-release* fn2-seals))
      (p-release (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-failed* fn2-seals))
      (p-failed (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-seals (fn2-seals-set-phase 0 *fn2-seal-phase-idle* fn2-seals))
      (fn2-overlays (fn2-overlays-set-phase 1 *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* fn2-overlays))
      (p-idle-sealable (fn2-seal-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-overlays))
      (fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-put 0 (unit 5) (counter 1) (slot 2) (gen 1)))
      ((mv c1 fn2-run-cache) (fn2-seal-cache 0 fn2-run-writers fn2-run-cache))
      (fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-put 0 (unit (+ 5 (fn2-run-cache-rows fn2-run-cache))) (counter 2) (slot 3) (gen 1)))
      ((mv c2 fn2-run-cache) (fn2-seal-cache 0 fn2-run-writers fn2-run-cache))
      (kept-unit (fn2-run-cache-unit (fn2-run-cache-row 5 fn2-run-cache) fn2-run-cache)))
  (fn2-su-mv (list p-idle-blocked p-build p-filter p-install p-release p-failed p-idle-sealable c1 c2 kept-unit))))

                                                (+ *fn2-su-fbase* *fn2-seal-field-rows* *fn2-run-entry-rows*) fn2-seals)))
  (fn2-su-mv code)))

;; Step until the seal row reaches *fn2-seal-phase-install*, occupy every free
;; installed-run row, and verify fn2-seal-step refuses :full WITHOUT retiring
;; any of the merge's live input runs or its frozen overlay.
(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-step-to-install (fuel) :measure (nfix fuel)
 (if (or (zp fuel) (equal (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals) *fn2-seal-phase-install*))
     (fn2-su-mv (equal (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals) *fn2-seal-phase-install*))
  (b* (((mv code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
            fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
            fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
        (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                       fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                       fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)))
   (if (eq code :more) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-step-to-install (- fuel 1)) (fn2-su-mv nil)))))

(defun fn2-su-fill-free-rows (k r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix k)))
 (if (or (zp k) (>= (nfix r) (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))) fn2-run-installed
  (let ((fn2-run-installed
         (if (equal (fn2-run-installed-state (nfix r) fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-free*)
             (fn2-run-installed-put (nfix r) (state *fn2-run-installed-state-live*) (schema 99) (run (+ 900 (nfix r))))
           fn2-run-installed)))
   (fn2-su-fill-free-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 (nfix r)) fn2-run-installed))))

(fn2-su-defun fn2-su-c5-mechanisms ()
 (b* (;; 1. Seal 2 runs of sid 8 (sizes 20, then 4 so size-tier leaves 2 runs on 8 rows),
      ;; then occupy 4 dummy rows of sid 99 so free-rows = 2 <= floor(8/3) = 2:
      ;; run-only compaction becomes pending with NO sealable overlays and merges sid 8 -> 1 run!
      (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-setup-cap 4 8 40 *fn2-run-page-size*))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup code)))
      (b1 (fn2-su-batch 0 20 100))
      (b2 (fn2-su-batch 10 4 200))
      (fn2-su-bind (code) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load 8 *fn2-su-groups* (list b1 b2) 0 '(1 2) nil))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load code)))
      (fn2-su-bind (dcode &) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive 100000 nil 0))
      (fn2-su-bind (runs-before) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-installed 0 8))
      (p-unpressured (fn2-seal-compact-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))
      ;; Occupy rows 2..5 with sid 99 singletons (1 run each), leaving free-rows = 2 <= 2
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put 2 (state *fn2-run-installed-state-live*) (schema 91) (run 501)))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put 3 (state *fn2-run-installed-state-live*) (schema 92) (run 502)))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put 4 (state *fn2-run-installed-state-live*) (schema 93) (run 503)))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put 5 (state *fn2-run-installed-state-live*) (schema 94) (run 504)))
      (p-pressured (fn2-seal-compact-pending-p fn2-seals fn2-run-installed fn2-pool))
      (pages-before (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool))
      (fn2-su-bind (ccode cdone) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive 100000 nil 0))
      (pages-after (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool))
      (sid8-after (fn2-seal-live-runs 8 0 8 fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-su-bind (ans-after) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-queries 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-queries*))
      ;; 2. Atomic multi-run replacement under :full at *fn2-seal-phase-install*:
      (fn2-su-bind (code2) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-setup-cap 4 8 40 *fn2-run-page-size*))
      ((unless (eq code2 :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :setup2 code2)))
      (fn2-su-bind (code2) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load 8 *fn2-su-groups* (list b1 b2) 0 '(1 2) nil))
      ((unless (eq code2 :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load2 code2)))
      (fn2-su-bind (& &) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-drive 100000 nil 0))
      ;; Load batch 3 (size 10 >= 4/2, so it merges with run 2, k >= 1):
      (b3 (fn2-su-batch 5 10 300))
      (fn2-su-bind (code3) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-load 8 *fn2-su-groups* (list b3) 2 '(3) nil))
      ((unless (eq code3 :ok)) (fn2-su-mv (list :load3 code3)))
      (fn2-su-bind (at-install) (fn2-su-call fn2-su-step-to-install 100000))
      (planned-k (fn2-seals-k 0 fn2-seals))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-su-fill-free-rows 8 0 fn2-run-installed))
      ((mv full-code fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts
           fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests
           fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths)
       (fn2-seal-step 4096 fn2-seals fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers
                      fn2-run-restarts fn2-run-cache fn2-ribbon-builds fn2-ribbon-band fn2-fields fn2-pool
                      fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests fn2-ranges fn2-range-sources fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths))
      (sid8-still-live (fn2-seal-live-runs 8 0 8 fn2-run-installed))
      (ov2-still-frozen (equal (fn2-overlays-phase 2 fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)))
  (fn2-su-mv (list dcode (len runs-before) p-unpressured p-pressured ccode cdone
                   (< pages-before pages-after) sid8-after
                   (equal ans-after (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* (list b1 b2) *fn2-su-queries*))
                   at-install (< 0 planned-k) full-code sid8-still-live ov2-still-frozen))))

(defconst *fn2-su-c5-batches*
 (list (fn2-su-batch 0 12 100) (fn2-su-batch 6 12 200) (fn2-su-batch 12 12 300) (fn2-su-batch 18 12 400)
       (fn2-su-batch 0 10 500) (fn2-su-batch 8 10 600) (fn2-su-batch 14 10 700) (fn2-su-batch 4 16 800)))

(defthm-owed fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims (batches queries pfill)
 (implies (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* batches)
               (consp batches) (<= (len batches) 8)
               (natp pfill) (<= 400 pfill) (<= pfill *fn2-run-page-size*))
          (let ((img (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* batches 4 24 pfill queries)))
           (and (equal (car img) :idle)
                (<= (len batches) (cadr img))
                (equal (caddr img) (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* batches queries))
                (<= (len (cadddr img)) 4)
                (< 16 (nth 4 img)))))
 :teeth (fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-positive fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-negative)
 :schema :invariant
 :doc "Minimal C5: sealing up to 8 batches across a 4-row installed-run table and 24-page pool merges superseded runs, reclaims their installed-run rows and 64 KiB page slots in :release, and preserves newest-wins lookup semantics.")

(defun fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-positive ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let* ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches* *fn2-su-queries*))
        (img (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-c5-batches* 4 24 400 *fn2-su-queries*))
        (sbatches (list (fn2-su-facts 0 6) (fn2-su-facts 3 6) (fn2-su-facts 6 6) (fn2-su-facts 9 6)))
        (squeries (list (fn2-su-fact 0 7) (fn2-su-fact 5 7) (fn2-su-fact 14 7) (fn2-su-fact 99 7)))
        (sspec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-summary-key* sbatches squeries))
        (simg (fn2-sealer-cap-image 13 *fn2-su-summary* sbatches 3 20 400 squeries)))
  (and (fn2-sealer-inputp *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches*)
       (equal (car img) :idle)
       (<= 8 (cadr img))
       (equal (caddr img) spec)
       (equal (cadddr img) '((8 8 30 0)))
       (equal (nth 4 img) 23)
       ;; Identity summary (schema 13) multi-run merge skips single-overlay Ribbon filter (filter = 0)
       (equal (car simg) :idle)
       (equal (caddr simg) sspec)
       (equal (cadddr simg) '((13 4 15 0)))
       (equal (nth 4 simg) 19)
       (equal (fn2-su-c5-mechanisms-result) '(:idle 2 nil t :idle 2 t 1 t t t :full 2 t)))))

(defun fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims-negative ()
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((spec (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* *fn2-su-c5-batches* *fn2-su-queries*))
       ;; Only 1 installed-run row cannot hold a live run plus a replacement row before retiring: :full
       (too-small (fn2-sealer-cap-image 8 *fn2-su-groups* *fn2-su-c5-batches* 1 24 400 *fn2-su-queries*))
       ;; Reversed batch order yields older values on overlapping keys, refuting oldest-wins merge
       (wrong-order (fn2-sealer-spec *fn2-su-groups-key* (reverse *fn2-su-c5-batches*) *fn2-su-queries*)))
  (and (eq (car too-small) :full)
       (not (equal wrong-order spec)))))

(fn2-assert-owed-teeth fn2-sealer-merge-reclaims)
